image_rules_en.with_chars: Exactly ONE cream-colored drop-shaped character with a young-grass-green scarf (the main character) appears in this picture. Any other characters are drop-shaped too but colored pink, light blue, brown or pale purple, never cream, and wear no scarf. Do not add characters the scene does not mention.
image_rules_en.without_chars: The cream-colored drop-shaped character with a green scarf does NOT appear in this picture. If the scene mentions characters, draw them as simple drop-shaped characters colored pink, light blue, brown or pale purple (never cream) with no scarf. Do not add characters the scene does not mention.
image_rules_en.nobody: Draw no people and no characters at all (no drop-shaped characters either). Books and papers carry no writing.
image_rules_en.always: All characters are simple drop-shaped figures with dot eyes and a small mouth: no clothes, no hair, smooth one-color bodies (only the main character's green scarf is an exception). Show age only with small props such as reading glasses, a cane or a bag. Draw exactly as many characters as the scene says. Never draw realistic humans.
